# pve_vm_resume (Action)

Resumes a suspended QEMU VM (`POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/status/resume`). The action waits for the resume task to finish.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Resume suspended VM 100 on node pve1.
action "pve_vm_resume" "resume_vm" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
    vmid = 100
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node running the VM.
- `vmid` (Number) The VM identifier. Must be between 100 and 999999999.
